column1: # disc_order_check.py --check: how many backward opens each scene window
# may make, recorded from a -DDB_IO_TRACE run of the disc build. A window
# that reaches back further than this is a load that started stepping:
# fix the order in tools/export/disc_layout.py MANIFEST, or raise the number here
# with the reason. Every one below is a reach the order cannot remove.
# bgm_bank_load reads bgm.pak at boot, before sndres reads the tables.
# The pair is ordered for the SCENE CHANGE instead (fgm_sounds.pak then
# bgm.pak), which happens once per scene; this happens once per run.
audio
# mncommon.spr belongs to the menus, which read it first; the character
# select reads it again rather than carry a second copy of 353 KB.
playersvs
# The stage select loads a preview on every cursor move, so which stages
# a run reads, and in what order, is the player's. The disc is in the
# icon grid's order (mnMapsGetGroundKind); a player walking it backwards
# walks the disc backwards, and eight is the whole grid.
maps
# Four reaches the battle cannot know in advance and one it repeats:
# the chosen stage's .stg and its gr* particle bank, the four players'
# stock icons out of the select, and efcommon.* which the select read
# first. Seven measured with a four-fighter roster.
vsbattle load
